test.text: Tab through the page and confirm focus lands on the <main> region.
Use a screen reader to verify it announces a main landmark.

steps: Ensure it contains the primary page content.
content.explanation: The page lacks a <main> landmark, so assistive users cannot locate the primary content. Adding a <main> element fixes this.

verification.note: This rule depends on the whole page, so a lone snippet can't be re-checked. Re-scan after applying it.
